holidays: Closed on Diwali and Holi. Holiday hours are announced on WhatsApp a week in advance.
facilities: Separate changing rooms with showers and lockers

plans.name: Monthly
plans.description: Full gym access, billed every month.

plans.name: Quarterly
plans.description: Full gym access for 3 months, paid upfront.

plans.name: Annual
plans.description: Full gym access for 12 months, paid upfront.

personalTraining.details: Certified trainers. Sessions are 60 minutes and scheduled directly with your trainer.

trial.details: One free trial session with a trainer walkthrough. Bring gym shoes and a water bottle.

policies: Memberships can be paused once per year for up to 30 days with prior notice.
Payments accepted: UPI, cash, debit/credit card at the front desk.

faqs.question: Is there a ladies-only batch?
faqs.answer: Yes, a ladies-only Zumba batch runs Mon/Wed/Fri at 11 AM.

faqs.question: Do you provide diet plans?
faqs.answer: Basic diet guidance is included with personal training packages.
